offers_products.reason: Core offering is money transfer; money orders and phone top-ups are minor add-ons at agent locations.

offers_services.reason: Remittance and money transfer service to Latin America, Africa and Asia, plus bill payment, via app, web and agents.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individuals send money to family abroad through the app, website and retail agent locations.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are individual senders; agents and payout partners are distribution partners, not main buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Migrant customers send money repeatedly, with resend features and referral offers encouraging repeat transfers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Family support remittances are essential and rarely postponed, even in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Money transfers are small, frequent transactions with modest fees.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the payment network, technology and agent partners, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual households sending remittances.

asset_heavy.reason: Uses third-party agent locations and bank and payout partners, with an app and web platform; no owned fleets or plants.
